title: TUI: view, edit and add slice notes
findings_note: split from S18: CLI slicer note landed; TUI should show notes and let e edit one, plus an affordance to add a note (list-entry add, unlike edit-in-place fields/sections).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
S18/S68 added dated item notes and a CLI `slicer note`, but the TUI could neither show nor edit
them. Split from S18.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- src/slicer/tui.py: notes in the detail pane (entries, panel, apply_edit_result, act).
- src/slicer/ops.py: set_note/remove_note helpers.
- tests/test_tui.py, tests/test_tui_style.py, tests/test_cli.py; README.md.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Show item notes in the detail pane for any item (bare or promoted). `e` on a note edits it in
`$EDITOR`; saving empty removes it. A trailing "+ add a note" entry, also via `e`, adds one,
dated through `ops.add_note` like the CLI. Entry/EditRequest gain a note index; entries() and
panel() stay in sync (the add line's entry index is the last entry).
